build_network: build a Haiku MLP network factory that approximates Q-values for a given number of hidden units and actions
create_onlineq_agent: create an online Q-learning agent with observation spec, action spec, hidden units, epsilon, and learning rate
run_q_learning_loop: run an online Q-learning training loop with the Catch environment, accumulator, and configurable episodes
accumulate_transitions: accumulate environment transitions with push, sample, and is_ready methods for online learning batches
compute_q_learning_loss: compute the Q-learning TD error loss using previous and current observations, action, reward, and discount
